required_behavior: accept one deterministic test ZIP whose exact outer SHA-256 is supplied by the caller
validate a strict manifest and reject malformed, duplicate, encrypted, directory, symbolic-link, path-escaping, oversized, content-set-mismatched, size-mismatched, and digest-mismatched packages
persist the validated package as exact opaque bytes under its SHA-256 content address
recompute SHA-256 from the persisted file and emit a receipt proving received_sha256 equals stored_sha256
never extract, import, invoke, execute, schedule, or grant authority to candidate payload bytes
forbidden_authority: candidate package writes outside the caller-supplied content store
